work_title: Replace lazy Stream collections from mempool with strict IndexedSeq (#1551)
description: Replaced lazy Stream collections from mempool with strict IndexedSeq in CandidateGenerator and NodeViewSynchronizer to prevent memory bloat and lazy evaluation bottlenecks (ergoplatform/ergo#1551). Implementation submitted in upstream PR https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2754.
